items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'Yeah that’s tough' to the interviewer's statement about being in a rock band and calling himself Billy Schechter. No personal connection or interaction is described.

ctx.x: Yeah. There’s a sense of reality and you can’t fool musicians when you do that. They know that when you’re doing that routine, “Oh he knows, he was there.” They get the little inside things you know. But I think people get that because when you graduate from high school the class always has to sing a song there on graduation day. The whole class is there and some vocal teacher, head of the drama department, whomever that is, they conduct this song and it’s usually a patriotic song or something, or “You’ll Never…

Yeah. They’ve all experienced it in some fashion. Yeah. As time went by did you find that filling a half an hour or whatever got easier? I shouldn’t talk about myself but I want to tell you that I was in a rock band for a while and somehow I ended up doing a 10- minute opening comedy routine. And I called myself Billy Schechter. And I found it was the hardest thing I’ve ever done.
